description: Ministry of Defence - The Award of the Prasansaneeya Seva Padakkama - 2024.
reasoning: This gazette announces the awarding of the Prashansaneeya Seva Padakkama (a service medal/decoration) to naval personnel. This falls under public service awards and recognitions, which is categorized under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with public sector service recognition and honors rather than government structural changes, personnel appointments, or other specialized categories.
